results.title: Catherine Bohart: Again, With Feelings
results.overview: Join Catherine Bohart, one of the UK and Ireland’s most exciting stand-up comedians, in her five-star (The Guardian) Edinburgh Comedy Award–nominated hit show Again, With Feelings.  This hilariously twisted stand-up comedy special is a second coming-of-age saga reckoning with death-obsessed parents, queer reproduction, and the growing realisation that adulthood, frankly, isn’t living up to expectations.

results.title: Nature: The Call for Reconciliation
results.overview: Combining poetry, science and emotion, this film traces the history of life, from its cosmic origins to its evolution on our planet, through the wonders of biodiversity and the contemporary challenges it faces. Through spectacular images, Yann Arthus-Bertrand questions the paradoxes of our times and urges a collective transformation to reconcile humanity with nature.

results.title: Mom Died
results.overview: Eight siblings just found out that their granddad died. A broken game of telephone happens, and then they all fight.

results.title: Anima
results.overview: A young woman and an old man embark on a road trip to preserve his consciousness at an experimental facility.

results.title: What She Didn't Tell Me
results.overview: When a disturbing overdose rocks her new town, a determined but grieving pharmacist must unravel the link between a growing teen drug crisis and a mysterious grief website before her own daughter becomes the next target.

results.title: They Took My Daugther
results.overview: When her daughter goes missing and kidnapped into a world of high-class corruption - a dishonorably discharged mom stops at nothing to find her.

results.title: Donn. Dancer of the 20th century
results.original_title: Donn, le danseur du XXe siècle
results.overview: At sixteen, Jorge Donn leaves Argentina for Brussels, where he becomes Maurice Béjart’s muse, lover and star dancer. Drawing on rare archival footage, Florencia Dávila and Mariano Baez bring this legendary performer vividly back to life: a body in perpetual motion, propelled by an almost inexhaustible need to dance.

results.title: Toilet Movie
results.overview: A series of scenes between two roommates all taking place in their shared bathroom.

results.title: Misery
results.overview: A theatre performance based on Tape (1999) play by Stephen Belber.

results.title: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
results.original_title: Chris Fleming: Live at The Palace
results.overview: From the Cadillac Palace Theatre in Chicago, comedian Chris Fleming bursts onto the screen with a fun and lighthearted blend of skillful storytelling and wild physicality in his first HBO stand-up special. A high-energy performer who seamlessly pivots from one everyday topic to another – from Trader Joe’s to Oreos, NPR, and dog breeds – Fleming bounds across the stage as he shares his unique takes on masculinity, conga lines, and more.

results.title: Bottled Up
results.overview: Simon decides to declare his love to his boss, Melanie, by hosting a romantic dinner at his mom's house. Over the course of the night, a number of unexpected guests show up leading to an onslaught of confusion.

results.title: My Husband's Sister
results.overview: A reformed con artist's second chance at love is threatened when a murderous caregiver from his past resurfaces.

results.title: Homecoming: The Tokyo Series
results.overview: In 2025, as MLB's Dodgers and Cubs clash in Tokyo for a historic season opener, their games become a lens into Japan's passionate baseball culture and the values that bind two nations through America's pastime.

results.title: Los Vampires
results.overview: In 1930 Hollywood, a Spanish actor is cast in the night shoot of a soon-to-be-legendary vampire film, forced to imitate the English-speaking star who performs the same role by day. The two actors regularly meet at the transitory hours of their shoots, and a rivalry stirs between them. All the while, a string of murders are occurring on and around the soundstage.

results.title: Тоже мне любовь
results.overview: Anya (33) organizes a bachelorette party for her younger sister Lina (25), who is about to marry her fiancé Omkar. While trying to make the evening special, Anya finds herself quietly unsettled by the upcoming wedding and the dynamics of Lina’s relationship. As the night unfolds and the celebration grows increasingly chaotic, Anya’s attempts to control the situation begin to spiral, forcing both sisters to confront difficult questions about love, expectations, and the choices they make.

results.title: TOVAH
results.overview: Through exclusive interviews, rare archival footage, and intimate behind-the-scenes access, TOVAH traces Tovah Feldshuh’s ascent from a daring young actress to a Broadway institution and cultural icon.

results.title: Bike Short
results.overview: When a mountain biker steals another’s “lucky” drying bike shorts, mistaking them for a curbside discard, a wild chase into the mountains ensues. Loosely based on a true story, the film attempts to answer the question, "Who would steal bike shorts?"

results.title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVII ~ Aoyi Transition ~
results.original_title: NJPW Yuji Nagata Produce Blue Justice XVII ~ Aoyi Transition ~
results.overview: Blue Justice XVII ~ Aoyi Transition ~ was a professional wrestling event produced by New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW) and organized by Yuji Nagata, which took place on January 18, 2026 at Sakura Civic Gymnasium in Sakura, Chiba, Japan.

results.title: Pumpkin Regatta Romance
results.overview: When their fathers refuse to move past a disagreement, Nadine, daughter of the boat shop owner, and Ethan, a pumpkin farmer, team up to heal the feud and revive the town's Pumpkin Regatta.
